title: Certified algebraic Tor restriction preserves normalized conormal wedges
statement: Let A,B be commutative rings, I,J ideals, φ:A→B, n≥0, and let q:Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I)→Tor_n^B(B/J,B/J) have the resolution certificate [new-t2-self-tor-restriction-certificate]. If g:Fin n→I and g':Fin n→J satisfy φ(g_j)=g'_j, then q carries selfTorConormalComparison_A applied to the pure wedge of the cotangent classes of g_j to selfTorConormalComparison_B applied to the pure wedge of the cotangent classes of g'_j [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. This is purely algebraic and requires neither flatness nor regularity.

proof.text: Choose the library projective quotient resolutions P,Q. Unpack the certificate to obtain ψ,a,k, their augmentation and tensor equations, and the equation for corresponding resolution cycles. Apply exists_koszul_restriction_test_cycles to obtain compatible normalized Koszul lifts and standard wedge cycle representatives.

Apply selfTorConormalComparison_spec over A and B to the two normalized lifts and standard-basis tuples. Finsupp.linearCombination_single reduces their exterior conormal arguments to the wedges of g and g'. Naturality of homologyπ rewrites these two values as the homology classes of the image cycles in P and Q.

Apply the certificate equation to the image cycles. Substitute the two normalization equations, cancel the inverse/hom composite of the P Tor isomorphism, and use injectivity of the Q Tor isomorphism. This proves the displayed wedge equation.

lean.statement: theorem selfTor_restriction_conormal_wedge (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (I : Ideal A) (J : Ideal B) (φ : A →+* B) (n : ℕ) (q : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) → (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} B) n).obj (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J))).obj (ModuleCat.of B (B ⧸ J)))) (hq : IsSelfTorRestrictionMap A B I J φ n q) (g : Fin n → I) (g' : Fin n → J) (hg : ∀ j, φ (g j) = g' j) : q (selfTorConormalComparison A I n (exteriorPower.ιMulti (A ⧸ I) n (fun j ↦ I.toCotangent (g j)))) = selfTorConormalComparison B J n (exteriorPower.ιMulti (B ⧸ J) n (fun j ↦ J.toCotangent (g' j)))
